data.text: Tap: the building nearest to you (within 2 hexes) is copied — a new building of the same kind, with the same bonus, rises on the free hex next to you that you pick; if you pick none (or it is not free), on a random free hex next to you. With no building within 2 hexes nothing happens and the ability stays ready. The copy carries the trap its source building hides (armed, even if the source's has already sprung); a copied dungeon is an unexplored dungeon.

ui.needs_hint: a building within 2 hexes to copy; optionally the free hex next to you where the copy rises (click it) — none picked: a random free hex next to you
